Stay Secure in Everyday Life

Stay alert and protect your personal information wherever you go.

Secure Browsing:
 

  • Only use trusted websites

  • Look for HTTPS in the URL

  • Use secure payment methods

  • Keep your browser and antivirus updated

  • Avoid clicking on pop-ups or suspicious ads

  • Don’t download files from unknown sources

  • Log out of accounts after use
     

Avoid Public Wi-Fi Risks:
 

  • Never access banking or sensitive accounts on public networks

  • Use a VPN when connecting to public Wi-Fi

Turn off auto-connect to open networks

Investor's Grievances Contacts and Escalation Matrix

Primary Contact

KFin Technologies Limited is the Company’s Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA).

All queries relating to shares, dividend payments, and other investor-related matters should be addressed to the RTA at the contact details given below.

 

Address:

KFin Technologies Limited

Unit: HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited (Equity ISIN: INE795G01014)

Selenium Tower B, Plot No. 31 & 32, Gachibowli,

Financial District, Nanakramguda,

Serilingampally,

Hyderabad - 500 032, India.

 

Contact No.: 040 - 6716 2222/ 7961 1000

Toll Free: 1800 309 4001

E-mail Id: einward.ris@kfintech.com

Website: www.kfintech.com

 

Escalation

Level 1

Ms Krishna Priya Maddula

KFin Technologies Limited

Selenium Tower B, Plot No. 31 & 32, Gachibowli,

Financial District, Nanakramguda,

Serilingampally,

Hyderabad - 500 032

E-mail Id: einward.ris@kfintech.com 

 

Level 2

In case a query/ grievance remains unresolved post correspondence with the RTA, investors may contact the Company Officials:

Ms Karishma/ Mr Jimit/ Mr Prasad (Secretarial Team)

E-mail Id: investor.service@hdfclife.com

Contact no.: 022-6751 6666

 

Level 3

In case a complaint is still not redressed to the investor's satisfaction, the investor may approach the Securities and Exchange Board of India and file their grievance through “SEBI SCORES”, the centralized online system for lodging and tracking complaints. SCORES can be accessed at https://scores.sebi.gov.in/

 

Online Dispute Resolution Mechanism

After exhausting these options for resolution of the grievance, if the investor is still not satisfied with the outcome, he/she/they can initiate dispute resolution through the ODR Portal - https://smartodr.in/login
